name: Documentation of Tiatr through Research Work
benefit:
> ***Publication Benefits***

- TAG will publish the research work in book form after thorough research on the subject.
- The publication may be in English or Konkani (Roman Script).
- TAG will print a minimum of 500 copies of the book.
- 100 copies will be given to the writer.
- The remaining copies will be used by TAG for various purposes.

> ***Financial Benefits***

The author/researcher will
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a researcher interested in writing books on tiatr after doing thorough research on the subject. - Preference will be given to any researcher who has already done research on any aspect of Tiatr, its Song & Music.
